sources.entry: SafeInCloud - Cross Platform password management, low cost app! [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/safeincloud-password-manager/id883070818?platform=mac)

summary.name: Safe (SafeInCloud)
summary.one_liner: Safe, also known as SafeInCloud, is a cross-platform password and passkey manager that stores encrypted logins in your own cloud or offline vault and autofills them across devices.
use_cases: Storing and autofilling logins across phone, tablet and computer
Backing up a password vault to Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or WebDAV/NAS
Checking whether accounts appear in known data breaches
Sharing separate work or family password vaults
Migrating saved passwords from Chrome, Firefox or Edge
summary.what_it_does: Safe stores passwords, passkeys, notes, bank cards and documents in an encrypted personal vault, using AES-256 and PBKDF2. It autofills logins in apps and browsers on Android, iOS, Windows and macOS, and in Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari. Vaults can be backed up automatically to a cloud service or WebDAV/NAS, and the page says data is kept in the user's cloud or offline rather than on Safe's servers. It also includes a password generator, a breach check powered by Have I Been Pwned, a built-in 2FA code generator, and import from other browsers and password managers.
notable: Data stored in user's own cloud (Google Drive, iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive) or offline, with no storage on Safe's servers per the page
Breach monitoring powered by Have I Been Pwned
Family license covering 6 members and a one-time Lifetime license option
Multiple separate vaults for work, family and personal data
caveats: Paid options exist: Individual or Family, subscription or Lifetime; current prices are only shown in the app
A 14-day free trial is mentioned, so full premium features appear to be paid
Cloud backup and sync depend on a third-party cloud or your own WebDAV/NAS setup
